description: The `ng` command line tool: `ng new`, `ng serve`, `ng generate`, `ng test`, `ng build`, `ng update`.
A component that lists its own dependencies in `imports` and needs no `NgModule`. The default since Angular 19.
Starts an application from a standalone root component and an `ApplicationConfig` with providers.
A reactive value container (`signal()`, `computed()`) that tells Angular precisely which views depend on it.
Change detection without zone.js, driven by signals and explicit notifications. The default for new apps since Angular 21.
The original 1.x framework (2010). Angular 2+ is a rewrite, not an upgrade.
